item.text:
Created [index.html](/private/tmp/pcd-sbx-codex-gpt-6.2-sol-medium-r1-izqmig79/work/index.html) as the only file in the working directory. It includes the 3D battlefield, all enemy and turret models, combat and collapse effects, the wordless HUD, deterministic replay controls, and synthesized audio.

- **Simulation:** Both reference hashes matched, `82a5353d` and `2e8858d7`. The listed air waypoints total 2,800 centi-tiles, and both vectors failed when I tested the stated 2,600 length. The simulator follows the waypoints.
- **Strategy:** The strategy combines route-specific build and upgrade priorities, late turret replacements, and targeting that weighs splash damage, urgency, and menders. It averaged **46.265 waves** across 20 held-out seeds. Seed 42 scored **47.33**, with the keep falling at **95.65 seconds**.
- **Browser verification:** Opened the file directly in WebKit, verified the playback controls, and confirmed that returning to the same scrub time produced pixel-identical frames. Late-wave playback measured **60 FPS at 1920×1080** in WebKit. Chrome performance and audible output remain unverified.
